title: If Workers Enjoy Tasks, Automation Can Increase Satisfaction While Reducing Pay
discussion_signal: NBER’s post frames automation as a change in the meaning and reward of retained work, not only a threat of job loss. A reply extends the signal: over-standardization and tighter boundaries can reduce the connection between judgment, capability, and outcomes even when work remains employed.
linked_research_question: How can automation change meaning, satisfaction, pay, and worker agency before it eliminates jobs?
limits: The post is not a representative worker sample
Meaning and satisfaction are distinct from long-run employment outcomes
Public search discovery is not a platform-native Creator/API export
